ensemble_fast.label: Fast fallback ensemble (CLIP ViT-B/16 probe + CNN)

clip_vitb16_final.label: UnivFD-style probe, CLIP ViT-B/16 final embedding

clip_vitb16_multi.label: Multi-layer CLIP ViT-B/16 probe (final + intermediate CLS)

freq.label: Spectral LR (azimuthal power spectrum + residual peaks)

head_selection.selection_rule: highest leave-one-family-out mean AUC on TRAIN->VAL (rounded to 3 dp; tie-break: VAL AUC)

latency.latency_ms_cpu_definition: median Detector.predict wall time, 1024x1024 upload, torch threads=2
latency.note: torch.set_num_threads(2) on arm64 with BLAS=accelerate. Apple AMX makes ViT GEMMs much faster than on a 2-vCPU x86 Space; Space numbers must be measured there (predict() returns latency_ms).
